# v2026.10.32

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.32.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.32.md).

This release covers **16 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Flow keeps its own price list, linked to Xero items and Seazona products, with a price check. ([#109](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/109))
- Flow imports the full Seazona job history, and matches each job to its Xero invoice. ([#114](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/114))
- Xero changes reach Flow through webhooks, a daily check and an hourly poll, and each sent invoice shows its Xero status. ([#139](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/139), [#133](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/133))
- Xero and Seazona calls stop after repeated failures, and the Xero page says how to start them again. ([#112](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/112), [#138](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/138))
- Any invoice opens as a PDF that Flow draws. ([#121](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/121))

## Changes

- Flow's own price list, linked to Xero items and Seazona products, with a price check. ([#109](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/109))
- Import full Seazona job history from the API, held in the ledger, matched to Xero, with job card issues. ([#114](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/114))
- A quiet alert line shows on a page only when something there needs a person. ([#124](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/124))
- The Xero page says when calls are stopped and how to start them again. ([#138](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/138))
- Preview any invoice as a PDF drawn by Flow. ([#121](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/121))
- Sidebar button with a panel icon; narrow menu opens as a drawer. ([#137](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/137))
- Xero webhooks, a daily check of the copy, and an hourly poll while webhooks arrive. ([#139](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/139))

## Fixes

- Xero calls stop after repeated failures, through one shared call guard. ([#112](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/112))
- Keep Xero's copy fresh, and show each sent invoice's Xero status with an out-of-sync alert. ([#133](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/133))
- A Seazona list at the row cap no longer stops its sync lane. ([#134](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/134))
- Account leaves the sidebar, and the account menu fits its rows. ([#120](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/120))
- A Seazona job fixed after a day can still draft; the feed reports an unchanged order again each hour. ([#145](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/145))
- Invoice Reference from a rule; send, Back and next on an invoice. ([#119](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/119))
